items.question: What is the chemical symbol for oxygen?
items.explanation: Each element has a short symbol. Oxygen is O, hydrogen is H and carbon is C. Symbols help scientists everywhere write chemistry the same way.

items.question: Gold is an element.
items.explanation: An element is a pure substance made of only one kind of atom. Gold is made only of gold atoms, so it is an element. Its symbol is Au, from the Latin word "aurum".

items.question: Which tiny particle in an atom has a negative charge?
items.explanation: An atom has protons (positive) and neutrons (no charge) in its centre, called the nucleus. Electrons (negative) move around the nucleus. Moving electrons are what we call electricity in wires.

items.question: The chemical symbol for sodium is ___.
items.explanation: Sodium's symbol is Na, from its Latin name "natrium". It is not "So". Sodium is found in common salt, sodium chloride (NaCl).

items.question: A carbon atom has 6 protons. How many electrons does a neutral carbon atom have?
items.explanation: In a neutral atom, the positive and negative charges balance. So the number of electrons equals the number of protons. Carbon has 6 protons, so it has 6 electrons.
